summary: Iteration 8 — Verified defensive MONGO_URL validation added at server.py:51-58 does not regress preview backend. Ran 6 smoke endpoint tests + 7 subprocess-based validation tests. All 13 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:51 correctly strips surrounding whitespace and both single/double quotes before scheme validation — matches the typical Railway paste-quirk where the value is wrapped in quotes in the UI.
The RuntimeError message truncates the URL to first 30 chars via repr — safe (won't leak full credentials in traceback) and helpful (shows enough for user to see missing scheme).

Validation runs at import time (before AsyncIOMotorClient is constructed) — this is the earliest possible failure point, so users get a clear error immediately on Railway boot rather than the cryptic pymongo.errors.InvalidURI later.
No downstream code depends on the raw un-stripped value, so the .strip().strip(quotes) transformation is safe.
Note: server.py is now ~1370 lines — approaching split-worthy size. Still non-blocking; already noted in iteration_7.
seed_data_creation: None. Login tests reused existing demo user; no writes to DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration8 verifies MONGO_URL defensive validation. test_iteration8_mongo_url_validation.py spawns python subprocesses with different MONGO_URL values (including invalid ones) — these do NOT affect the live supervised backend. Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration8_*.py -o addopts=''` to avoid xdist worker races. Preview .env still has MONGO_URL='mongodb://localhost:27017' (with double quotes, which is exactly the case the new .strip('"') handles).
rca of the issue: No bug present — this was a proactive defensive-code change to give Railway users a clearer error when they paste a malformed MONGO_URL. Verified: (1) valid mongodb:// and mongodb+srv:// pass through, (2) surrounding quotes and whitespace are stripped, (3) invalid schemes (missing prefix, http://, empty) raise RuntimeError with helpful message, (4) all 6 live endpoints (root, login, /auth/me, accounts, transactions, analytics/summary) still return 200 on preview backend.
